# ${module_id} - Expensive or external readiness proof

## Module contract and selection

@@SELECTION@@

Prove fragile execution/control machinery cheaply before spending an expensive runner or scarce,
irreversible external attempt. Recordability preflight and external rehearsal are genuinely optional
profiles inside one readiness module. Decide each as `SELECTED: the selected concrete action` or
`OMITTED: the concrete project reason`. Strongly select recordability preflight for fragile custom
runners and external rehearsal for scarce, irreversible, hardware, service, or other external control
flows; these examples are recommendations, not exhaustive eligibility gates.

## Public interface and compatibility boundary

changed expensive-control contract + disposable fakes -> readiness only, never real product acceptance. Concrete values and return targets belong to the owning step's configured instance. Private changes do not alter public semantics; update actual consumers for a real contract change.

## Rules, process, recipe actions, and allowed variations

P01–P15 own shared rules. Semantic choices in recipe verbs remain ROOT decisions; test_root only authors declared lane-local contracts. Workers mechanically execute supplied choices and return any missing meaning. Reviewer findings remain open within assigned boundaries. Each governing card cites all actions; member cards cite only their ordered subset. Parameters may select bounded source/test paths and optional profiles, never weaken acceptance or change authority.

| Order | Recipe action ID | Project-specific action/process | Allowed parameterization | Decision owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | M08-A1 | Check whether prior readiness work still applies under unchanged relevant inputs; stop if it does. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |
| 2 | M08-A2 | SELECTED: For a fragile custom runner, execute one side-effect-free fake and check inputs, process/worker IDs needed for correlation, timing, command, outputs, cleanup, readback, and exit. When checkpointed verification is selected, also check checkpoint write/read and the unit-resume boundary. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |
| 3 | M08-A3 | SELECTED: For an external flow, exercise exact admission, target binding, retained authorization, observation, stop/abort, idempotence/recovery, cleanup, and terminal closure against disposable local fakes. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |
| 4 | M08-A4 | Verify no product, service, deployment, hardware, or scarce namespace was consumed. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |
| 5 | M08-A5 | Publish profile results separately under one module output; persist input comparison data only if reuse needs it. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |
| 6 | M08-A6 | On procedure/report failure that still blocks the exact expensive/real operation, rerun each failed, input-affected, or uncertain readiness profile in declared order beginning with its earliest required action; reuse only an unaffected prior PASS. Otherwise record and stop readiness work. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |

- Pass unlocks only the checked downstream operation and never counts as a product pass.
- Failure blocks only the exact expensive/real operation, never an independently decidable product result
  or other release work, and does not invalidate unrelated product credit.
- A project may omit either profile only with its recorded free-form justification; omission decides
  that optional profile and cannot relax M08's selected-instance, card, result, or validation contracts.
